rubrics.justification: The response incorrectly states morphology cannot be assessed despite explicit Gardner data being provided (3AA expanded blastocyst with excellent ICM and TE), so it omits key available morphological features.
It integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, sperm motility, endometrium, and first-cycle status well with prognosis, though it fails to connect these to the known 3AA morphology.
Reasoning is generally logical, but it is weakened by treating embryo morphology as unknown when it was actually provided, making the probability estimate less well supported.

Most recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice (SET, luteal support, review of cycle data), but suggesting ERA/endometrial scratch after a single failed transfer is not strongly guideline-supported, and omission of the provided Gardner grade reduces alignment.
Provides practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including SET and review of embryo development, though some suggestions are somewhat generic or premature.
